priority_scheme.high: Stage 6 HDBSCAN noise and high Isolation Forest novelty
priority_scheme.medium: high novelty without a known Stage 6 noise label
priority_scheme.review: Stage 6 noise but below the novelty cutoff
priority_scheme.normal: Stage 6 cluster and below the novelty cutoff
priority_scheme.not_clustered: validation/test sample below novelty cutoff; Stage 6 did not cluster it

queue_policy: one highest-novelty flagged segment per recording
